summary: Customer wants an optical measurement during yeast fermentation to follow growth and notice changes earlier. They mention a biomass signal and a metabolic signal but have not defined them as separate targets. The broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops. They want help turning this into an initial feasibility study with useful reference measurements.
